description: This file defines a Log class implementing a file and console logger using Python's logging facilities, with configurable log levels, colors, and output destinations. It includes methods for different log levels and manages preferences via a Prefs backend.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logger class that handles logging messages to console and file with different severity levels, using preferences for configuration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Log object, setting up preferences, console, and logfile parameters.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a log message to the logfile with timestamp and level.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Performs the actual logging, directing output to file and/or console based on preferences.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message with caller info.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an error message with a full stack trace.
